courseOutcomes.statement: Have a fundamental knowledge of the concepts of Statistics.
Have a notion of sampling distributions and statistical techniques used in Engineering problems.
Analyse and interpret the data based on the sample tests.
Apply the basic concepts of classification of design of Experiments in the field of Engineering.
Design and interpret control charts for variables and attributes.

units.title: Descriptive Statistics
units.description: Measures of central tendency, dispersion, skewness, and kurtosis.
topics: Arithmetic Mean
Median and Mode
Harmonic Mean and Geometric Mean
Quartiles and Quartile Deviation
Variance and Standard Deviation
Coefficient of Variation
Karl Pearson's Coefficient of Skewness
Bowley's Coefficient of Skewness
Kurtosis and Moments

units.title: Sampling Distributions and Large Sample Tests
units.description: Sampling distributions, hypothesis formulation, and large sample Z-tests.
topics: Null and Alternative Hypotheses
Type I and Type II Errors
Critical Region and Level of Significance
Standard Error
Test of Significance for Single Mean (Z-test)
Test of Significance for Difference of Means (Z-test)
Test of Significance for Single Proportion (Z-test)
Test of Significance for Difference of Proportions (Z-test)
Test for Difference of Standard Deviations

units.title: Small Sample Tests
units.description: Exact sampling distributions including Student's t, Snedecor's F, and Chi-Square tests.
topics: Student's t-Test for Single Mean
Student's t-Test for Difference of Two Means
Paired t-Test
F-Test for Equality of Two Variances
Chi-Square Test for Goodness of Fit
Chi-Square Test for Independence of Attributes
Contingency Tables

units.title: Design of Experiments
units.description: Principles of experimental design, analysis of variance, and experimental layouts.
topics: Principles of Design of Experiments
One-Way Classification ANOVA
Two-Way Classification ANOVA (Randomized Block Design)
Latin Square Design (LSD)
ANOVA Table Construction and F-Ratio Interpretation
Degrees of Freedom Calculation

units.title: Statistical Quality Control
units.description: Theory of control charts, control limits, and process capability for variables and attributes.
topics: Introduction to SQC and Causes of Variation
Control Limits vs Specification and Tolerance Limits
Control Charts for Variables: Mean Chart (X-bar chart)
Control Charts for Variables: Range Chart (R chart)
Control Charts for Attributes: Fraction Defective Chart (p-chart)
Control Charts for Attributes: Number of Defectives Chart (np-chart)
Control Charts for Attributes: Number of Defects Chart (c-chart)
